summary: Frontend regression + NEW weight-based shipping/qty-cap features. All 7 requested flows PASS on the mobile web preview (viewport 390x844). (1) 20 x Aloe & Cucumber Gel (180g each) in cart: Subtotal Rs.9,580, Shipping label 'Rs.50 (3.6 kg)', Total Rs.9,630 -- shipping stepper cap allowed adding 20 (item <500g so cap is 99). (2) Small cart (qty 1) shows Shipping 'Free' and Total = Subtotal. (3) Full demo checkout with the heavy 20-piece cart: Checkout summary shows Shipping Rs.50 (3.6 kg), Pay button label reads 'Pay with Razorpay . Rs.9,630', reached /order-success?order_id=af219bbc-... and backend GET /api/orders/{id} returns amount:9630.0, subtotal:9580.0, shipping_charge:50.0, total_weight_grams:3600.0, status:paid -- backend total EXACTLY matches frontend Total. (4) Admin edit product form renders 'Weight in grams (for shipping)' with testID form-weight-grams; loads existing value on edit (verified value=500 after PUT) and hint text explains free/50/100 tiers + 500g rule. (5) Quantity cap: after PUT-setting Ashwagandha Root Extract weight_grams=500, product detail shows 'Max 2 pcs per order (item weighs 500g or more)' and stepper caps at 2 despite 6 + clicks; cart shows 'Max 2 pcs per order (500g+ item)' and cart stepper also caps at 2. Reverted weight_grams to 120 after test. (6) Regression: home renders logo, hero, 'Altos ID Holder? Log in' box, Bestsellers row, category chips (All/Skincare/Supplements), and product grid. Admin > Orders tab renders 29 orders, Shiprocket 'Link' card, 27 whatsapp-{id} buttons, 8 mark-shipped-{id} buttons; iteration-4's statusMeta bug is FIXED -- shipped/delivered badges now render correctly (verified 'Paid' and 'Delivered' badges in screenshot). No red-screen errors, navigation works between Shop/Cart/Admin tabs and Expo Router /product/{id}, /cart, /checkout, /order-success, /admin/product-form.

minor.issue: ProductCreate model does not accept the 'featured' field, so any admin/API update silently resets stored featured=true back to false. Aloe & Cucumber Gel still has featured=true because we did not PUT it, but Ashwagandha now has featured=false after this test PUT (bestseller correctly stayed true). Low priority -- 'featured' is not surfaced anywhere in the reviewed UI paths; but if admin ever wants to control it, it needs to be added to ProductCreate or preserved on update.

issues: CormorantGaramond .ttf files fail to decode on web preview: 'OTS parsing error: invalid sfntVersion: 168430090'. Falls back to system serif; purely cosmetic on web. Also flagged in iterations 3 and 4 -- unchanged.

react_native_issues.component: Some component still using pointerEvents prop
react_native_issues.issue: Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still appears on nearly every page load. RN 0.79+ requires migrating to style.pointerEvents. Same warning was flagged in iteration_4.

action_items: (LOW) server.py ProductCreate: consider including 'featured: bool = False' or preserve existing value on update so PUT does not silently reset it to false.
(LOW / carry-over) Migrate any remaining pointerEvents='...' props to style={{pointerEvents:'...'}} for RN 0.79+ compatibility.
(COSMETIC / carry-over) CormorantGaramond .ttf files fail OTS parsing on web preview -- non-blocking, system serif fallback used.
critical_code_review_comments: src/utils/pricing.ts shippingCharge() tiers (>5000 -> 100, >3000 -> 50, else 0) match user rules exactly. isHeavyItem uses >=500g threshold and maxQtyFor returns 2 for heavy / 99 otherwise -- correct.
CartContext.addItem and setQuantity both clamp with maxQtyFor -- verified in UI that 6 clicks of + on a 500g item ends at 2 in both product-detail and cart steppers.

cart.tsx and checkout.tsx compute shipping/total from CartContext (single source of truth) so numbers cannot drift between screens; verified frontend Total = backend order amount = 9630 for the 20 x Aloe scenario.
product-form.tsx correctly reads/writes weight_grams and shows a hint documenting tiers + 500g cap. Field testID matches request (form-weight-grams).
checkout.tsx pay-button label is derived from cart total including shipping -- verified label 'Pay with Razorpay . Rs.9,630'.

success_rate.backend: 100% (all 7 requested checks; backend order total matches frontend total; PUT product weight_grams round-trips)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (7/7 requested flows: 20-piece heavy cart, small-cart free shipping, full demo checkout, admin form field, product-page qty cap, cart qty cap, home + admin-orders regression)
